items.title: Introduction
items.text: Welcome to the Nextflow Schemas documentation. This repository contains JSON schemas used by Nextflow for validating pipeline inputs and plugin specifications.

items.title: Overview
items.text:
This repository provides two main schemas:

  • Pipeline Input Schema: Validates Nextflow pipeline input specifications, including parameter definitions, validation rules, and parameter grouping
  • Plugin Schema: Validates Nextflow plugin specifications, including configuration scopes and function definitions
